title: Free Trial with Auto M1 Trade and Auto Timings
features:
Auto block & counter – Blocks when an opponent starts an M1, then counter-attacks
Distance-based targeting – Only reacts to opponents within a configurable range
Team check – Ignores teammates, blocks only enemies
Fist & sword M1 detection – Supports fist, sword, and air variants
Combat
Dash compensation – Expands block range when you or the opponent dash
Configurable block duration – Set how long the block is held before the counter
Debounce – Reduces double triggers on fast M1s

Nanami timing – Clicks the Nanami cutter bar at the right point
7:3 second activation – Press 2 to trigger the follow-up hit
Tunable timing – Adjust target X and click window

Zoom timing – Clicks when the camera zooms out past a FOV threshold
Compatible with – Toji oneshot, Law, and similar zoom-based skills
Visuals & Controls
Distance circle – Shows the block range radius

Debug mode – Extra logs for timing and targeting

Live config – Adjust settings via globals without rejoining
